independent.summary: The fix only disarms the document-level hotkey handler while the drawer is hidden; the other half of the same leak remains — with the drawer open (it is a floating panel, the host page stays interactive) a `y`/`n`/`1`-`4`, or Enter in 'select' behavior with a pendingValue, typed into the HOST page's own form field is still preventDefault()ed and silently POSTed to /chat, because `e.target === input` only exempts the widget's own input and no check excludes editable targets outside the widget.

triageGrades.reason: The diff is widget keydown gating plus a smoke test; no auth, tokens, roles or middleware involved.
No credentials, keys or env vars appear in either changed file's diff.
No billing, Stripe, pricing or quota code is touched.
No deletions, migrations or data-mutating operations; only an in-browser event guard and test additions.

The change's whole purpose is gating whether a POST to the backend /chat endpoint fires, and the new smoke assertions count those POSTs, so the outbound-API category is genuinely in play (the cited line number is off but evidence quality is not graded).
No version bumps, deploy config, nixpacks/railway files or build scripts are in the diff.
